verdict: REFUTES 'high-ratio purges' hypothesis: compaction COMPLETED but deleted vectors STILL recoverable after 80s GC wait; store grows monotonically -> old segments not GC'd in window. Milvus durable in tested window even at high ratio.
caveat: cannot claim Milvus never GCs; only that aggressive-config GC did not collect old segments within 80s of completed compaction.
